verdict.rationale: Hightouch's sync docs describe scheduled/triggered syncs, CDC, and run debugging, but there is no evidence of replaying archived events or backfilling historical data into a new destination when a pipeline breaks or a tool is added; Hightouch Events pipes live behavioral events into the warehouse, not archived-event replay. missing for 10: any mention of event/data replay, backfill mechanisms, historical resync into new destinations, or reprocessing archived data after pipeline failure.
